free_tier.stated: No general free text tier; text models are billed per million tokens. A free quota exists only for selected 3D models (e.g. 2M/150K/500K tokens) and Managed Agents (30 hours runtime + 500 web_search calls, 2-year validity).

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable: an inference endpoint stores nothing for the caller

egress.terms: the response is the payload; no separate egress term is published

tooling: OpenAI-compatible SDK against the Ark endpoint
chaining: free quota is limited to 3D and Managed Agents, not general text inference

identity_cost.detail: a Volcengine account and API key; signup fields not detailed on this page
